blurb:
Fresh pasta is simpler than you think. This hands-on class in Detroit, hosted through Cozymeal, which connects you with top-rated local chefs, strips Italian cooking back to its essentials – dough made by hand, sauce made from scratch and a tiramisù to finish. Perfect for beginners and home cooks looking to level up.

Your hands-on cooking experience features:
- Bruschetta – fresh tomato and basil on toasted bread
- Fresh Pasta – tagliatelle or gnocchi with classic tomato-basil sauce
- Tiramisù – mascarpone, cacao and espresso-soaked ladyfinger biscuits

You will leave with solid handmade pasta technique and the confidence to recreate this three-course Italian meal at home anytime.
